sponsors.name: Phantom
sponsors.content:
Phantom Connect is the recommended embedded wallet for all Colosseum hackathon projects. Ship wallet functionality in minutes — with seamless email sign-in for web2 users and native support for existing Phantom users — at no cost.

- [Get Started](https://docs.phantom.com/phantom-connect)
- [Integration Guide](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_TSqD9wTO-VQMUoUqMQZ8TSoxVx5YuWz/view)
- [React Starter Template](https://github.com/Th3Ya0vi/phantom-embedded-react-starter)
- [JS Template](https://github.com/Th3Ya0vi/phantom-embedded-js)
- [React Native Template](https://github.com/Th3Ya0vi/phantom-embedded-react-native-starter)

Stop paying for auth and wallet infrastructure. Phantom Connect gives your project production-grade wallet UX, email onboarding for web2 users, and native support for existing crypto users — all with a few lines of code. Also ready for agentic use cases via the Phantom MCP Server.

In addition, CASH is the recommended stablecoin for Colosseum hackathon transactions and prize payouts. Backed by Phantom, purpose-built for Solana. Integrate a stablecoin that your users already hold in Phantom and is accepted across Stripe's global merchant network. Reduce friction for in-app payments, tipping, and commerce flows. CASH also lets you keep 100% of the net revenue generated from the supply you originate.

- [Get Started with CASH](https://docs.phantom.com/cash)

sponsors.name: Altitude
sponsors.content:
Multisig secures what you build. Altitude runs the business.

Both products are built by Squads. Five years of financial infrastructure on Solana, securing over $15B in tokenized value.

Squads Multisig is Solana's premier multisig platform. Secure your program upgrade authorities, project tokens, and validator keys with multi-party approval. Over 500 of Solana's leading teams trust Multisig to secure their Solana assets, including Helius, Jito, Kamino, Jupiter, MetaDAO and more.

- [Get Started with Multisig](https://squads.xyz/multisig)

Altitude is the financial operating system for businesses on the frontier. Secure your stablecoin treasury, spend with cards, earn APY on balances, and move money globally with ACH, SEPA and SWIFT.

Altitude is how Solana's leading teams run their financial operations.

Learn more:

- [Altitude Website](https://altitude.xyz)
- [Altitude on X](https://x.com/altitude)

sponsors.name: Reflect
sponsors.content:
Reflect is credibly-neutral stablecoin software, where the software consists of decentralized financial strategies executed and managed permissionlessly by programs rather than humans. Reflect then tokenizes these strategies in the form of interest-bearing US Dollars (stablecoins).

- [Docs](https://docs.reflect.money/)
- [@reflectmoney/stable.ts](https://npmjs.com/package/@reflectmoney/stable.ts)

sponsors.name: Meteora
sponsors.description: Permissionless token launch infrastructure: define how a token launches, trades, and graduates into Meteora liquidity through a configurable on-chain bonding curve.
sponsors.content:
Meteora DBC is Meteora's permissionless token launch infrastructure. Define how a token launches, trades, and graduates into Meteora liquidity, all through a configurable on-chain bonding curve.

- [Get Started with Meteora DBC](https://docs.meteora.ag/developer-guides/dbc)
- [Invent CLI](https://docs.meteora.ag/invent/actions)
- [Next.js Scaffold Template (Fun Launch)](https://docs.meteora.ag/invent/scaffold/fun-launch)
- [TypeScript SDK](https://docs.meteora.ag/developer-guides/dbc/typescript-sdk/getting-started)
- [NPM Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@meteora-ag/dynamic-bonding-curve-sdk)
- [Agent Skill](https://docs.meteora.ag/agents/skill)

We believe there is a lot left to tokenize, so we need more innovative launchpads. Meteora lets you build a launchpad that does stock pairs, ICM pairs, meme pairs, and fully custom pair setups: more asset classes on the same liquidity layer.

For liquidity-related integrations, check out the [Meteora docs](https://docs.meteora.ag/get-started).

links.description: The official skills index includes Foundation-maintained skills and labels community contributions separately. It reinforces the current Kit and LiteSVM/Mollusk/Surfpool testing path; community skills are not Solana endorsements.

Browse Metaplex registry entries, but do not treat provider-supplied agent and token metadata as independent security endorsements.
Use Metaplex's current portal for tokenization and digital asset APIs.

resources.title: Privacy + Confidential Compute
resources.summary: Build encrypted applications with private state and secure computation.

links.description: Arcium's maintained documentation explains its encrypted-computation network and Solana integration. The technology adds a distinct compiler, network, and threat model and is optional for apps that truly require confidential computation.

This developer section supplies the actionable Arcis and Anchor-compatible build path, distinct from the conceptual docs home. Builders still need to validate network availability and security assumptions for their use case.

Hide transfer amounts and confidential balances with Token-2022 confidential transfers. Addresses, mints, and owners remain public; both accounts need the extension, stock solana-test-validator lacks the proof program, transfers may require several transactions, and Rust and JavaScript clients differ.

resources.title: Governance / DAOs
resources.summary: Build governance and DAO tooling on Solana.

links.description: The live Solana governance application remains available. It is useful as a product/protocol destination, while implementers should follow its linked SDK/program sources for versioned developer work.
MetaDAO maintains product and protocol documentation for its Solana governance and market mechanisms. Keep as a specialized integration/reference, not a general governance default.

resources.title: Treasury + Security
resources.summary: Secure assets, manage treasuries, and run financial operations.

links.description: The live product is backed by the public Squads v4 repository, updated 2026-08-20. Its SDK uses web3.js v1 while the program uses Anchor 0.32, making it useful production evidence with an explicit legacy boundary.

resources.summary: Company setup, banking, and compliance resources for founders building in any ecosystem.

rpcProviders.name: Triton One
rpcProviders.description: Shared and dedicated Solana RPC infrastructure with JSON-RPC, WebSockets, and Yellowstone gRPC streaming. A paid option for teams that need custom deployments or higher throughput. Pay-as-you-go pricing requires a $125 prepaid minimum.

rpcProviders.name: Quicknode
rpcProviders.description: Solana RPC endpoints for mainnet, devnet, and testnet, with JSON-RPC and WebSocket support for sending transactions and subscribing to on-chain updates.

sponsors.name: Phantom
sponsors.content:
Phantom Connect is the recommended embedded wallet for all Colosseum hackathon projects. Ship wallet functionality in minutes — with seamless email sign-in for web2 users and native support for existing Phantom users — at no cost.

- [Get Started](https://docs.phantom.com/phantom-connect)
- [Integration Guide](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_TSqD9wTO-VQMUoUqMQZ8TSoxVx5YuWz/view)
- [React Starter Template](https://github.com/Th3Ya0vi/phantom-embedded-react-starter)
- [JS Template](https://github.com/Th3Ya0vi/phantom-embedded-js)
- [React Native Template](https://github.com/Th3Ya0vi/phantom-embedded-react-native-starter)

Stop paying for auth and wallet infrastructure. Phantom Connect gives your project production-grade wallet UX, email onboarding for web2 users, and native support for existing crypto users — all with a few lines of code. Also ready for agentic use cases via the Phantom MCP Server.

In addition, CASH is the recommended stablecoin for Colosseum hackathon transactions and prize payouts. Backed by Phantom, purpose-built for Solana. Integrate a stablecoin that your users already hold in Phantom and is accepted across Stripe's global merchant network. Reduce friction for in-app payments, tipping, and commerce flows. CASH also lets you keep 100% of the net revenue generated from the supply you originate.

- [Get Started with CASH](https://docs.phantom.com/cash)

sponsors.name: Altitude
sponsors.content:
Multisig secures what you build. Altitude runs the business.

Both products are built by Squads. Five years of financial infrastructure on Solana, securing over $15B in tokenized value.

Squads Multisig is Solana's premier multisig platform. Secure your program upgrade authorities, project tokens, and validator keys with multi-party approval. Over 500 of Solana's leading teams trust Multisig to secure their Solana assets, including Helius, Jito, Kamino, Jupiter, MetaDAO and more.

- [Get Started with Multisig](https://squads.xyz/multisig)

Altitude is the financial operating system for businesses on the frontier. Secure your stablecoin treasury, spend with cards, earn APY on balances, and move money globally with ACH, SEPA and SWIFT.

Altitude is how Solana's leading teams run their financial operations.

Learn more:

- [Altitude Website](https://altitude.xyz)
- [Altitude on X](https://x.com/altitude)

sponsors.name: Reflect
sponsors.content:
Reflect is credibly-neutral stablecoin software, where the software consists of decentralized financial strategies executed and managed permissionlessly by programs rather than humans. Reflect then tokenizes these strategies in the form of interest-bearing US Dollars (stablecoins).

- [Docs](https://docs.reflect.money/)
- [@reflectmoney/stable.ts](https://npmjs.com/package/@reflectmoney/stable.ts)

sponsors.name: Meteora
sponsors.description: Permissionless token launch infrastructure: define how a token launches, trades, and graduates into Meteora liquidity through a configurable on-chain bonding curve.
sponsors.content:
Meteora DBC is Meteora's permissionless token launch infrastructure. Define how a token launches, trades, and graduates into Meteora liquidity, all through a configurable on-chain bonding curve.

- [Get Started with Meteora DBC](https://docs.meteora.ag/developer-guides/dbc)
- [Invent CLI](https://docs.meteora.ag/invent/actions)
- [Next.js Scaffold Template (Fun Launch)](https://docs.meteora.ag/invent/scaffold/fun-launch)
- [TypeScript SDK](https://docs.meteora.ag/developer-guides/dbc/typescript-sdk/getting-started)
- [NPM Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@meteora-ag/dynamic-bonding-curve-sdk)
- [Agent Skill](https://docs.meteora.ag/agents/skill)

We believe there is a lot left to tokenize, so we need more innovative launchpads. Meteora lets you build a launchpad that does stock pairs, ICM pairs, meme pairs, and fully custom pair setups: more asset classes on the same liquidity layer.

For liquidity-related integrations, check out the [Meteora docs](https://docs.meteora.ag/get-started).
